_meta.placement: Draw over the wall face cell, after the wall layer. Cell 0 is the doorway and is drawn once; cells 1..n are the door leaf, frame 0 closed through frame n-1 nearly retracted. The fully open state is drawing no leaf at all -- it is not stored, because it is empty. Closing is the same frames in reverse order, also not stored twice.
